title.zh: 泰勒级数 · 把曲线一项项贴上去
title.en: Taylor Series · Patch the Curve Term by Term

desc.zh: 多项式一项项加上去，曲线在一点附近被逐段贴合到重合；这是“局部”的逼近，与傅里叶“整体”的逼近恰成对照。
desc.en: Add a polynomial term by term and the curve gets matched ever farther around one point; this is a “local” approximation, the counterpart of Fourier’s “global” one.
